run_spm_decode_pieces: run the sentencepiece decode script to decode piece tokens from an input file using a model
run_spm_decode_ids: run the sentencepiece decode script to decode integer IDs from an input file using a model
run_spm_decode_unk: run the sentencepiece decode script to decode tokens remapping <<unk>> tokens to ID 0
review_main: review the main function that parses args and decodes sentencepiece tokens line by line
refactor_decode: refactor the decode function to support additional input formats beyond piece and id
